duster.headline: No new stock this run; the standout is the 2022 1.5dCi Zen at R209,990 (R24,273 under model) if manual is acceptable, while the 2022 TechRoad Auto at R249,900/47,051 km (+R12,185) is the best fit to the auto/diesel/2020+ brief at a trade-in-friendly multi-franchise.

shortlist.note: Standout bargain: 2022 1.5dCi Zen, R209,990 with 72,000 km — R24,273 under model, cheapest 2020+ diesel on the board; manual not auto, but the gap beats every auto here; Jetour Hillcrest is multi-franchise, better odds on the 2014 dCi 4x4 trade.
Best match to the brief: 2022 TechRoad Auto diesel, R249,900, 47,051 km, +R12,185 under model; KIA Ballito (multi-franchise) is the natural home for the 2014 4x4 trade-in.

Cheapest auto diesel: 2019 Dynamique Auto, R195,000, 88,500 km, +R5,717 under model — one year below the 2020 target but ~R55k less than the 2022 autos; Super Auto is an independent, so get the trade-in quote in writing.
Near-new play: 2023 Zen, R244,900 with only 44,460 km, +R12,761 under model; manual, at Durban Multifranchise (KIA) — trade-in friendly if they want the newest car.

caddy.headline: Baseline capture shows a thin market: one listing, a 2020 1.6 Crew Bus at R279,990 with 76,000 km — inside both caps with ~R20k headroom; expect cheaper panel vans to define the real market in future captures.

shortlist.note: Only option so far: 2020 1.6 Crew Bus (windowed Kombi-style, not a panel van), R279,990, 76,000 km — R20,010 under the price cap and 24,000 km under the km cap; treat as baseline, not a bargain, and verify mechanicals before committing.

jimny.headline: Baseline of three, all 2-door (no 5-doors in this capture): the 2018 1.3 at R234,890/86,000 km is the cheapest viable route, while new-gen GLX options crowd the R289,890–R295,995 top of the R300k cap.

shortlist.note: Cheapest viable: 2018 1.3 old-gen 2-door, R234,890, 86,000 km — R65,110 under the cap with 14,000 km of headroom; at this age/km budget for a thorough mechanical inspection.
Newest-gen value: 2020 1.5 GLX AllGrip, R289,890, 78,000 km — R10,110 under the cap; Jetour Ballito is multi-franchise, useful for the Peugeot 108 trade.
Lowest km by far: 2021 GLX AllGrip, R295,995, 25,115 km — but only R4,005 under the cap and no dealer listed (likely private sale), which rules out the 108 trade-in.
